sloka: जनस्थान स्थिता राजन् रक्षसा बहवो हताः ।खरः च निहतः संख्ये क्थम्चित् अहम् आगतः ॥३-३१-२॥
transliteration: janasthāna sthitā rājan rakṣasā bahavo hatāḥ ।kharaḥ ca nihataḥ saṁkhye kthamcit aham āgataḥ ॥3-31-2॥

translations.english: O king many demons dwelling at Janasthana including Khara have been killed. I manged to escape with much difficulty.
